attr.title: Little Big Adventure 2
attr.desc: Twinsen's world is invaded by the Esmers, who are stealing the children of Twinsun. A 1997 isometric action-adventure, now widescreen and playable on a pad.
attr.desc_md: Twinsen's world is invaded by the Esmers, who are stealing the children of Twinsun. A 1997 isometric action-adventure, built on [LBA2 Classic Community](https://github.com/LBALab/lba2-classic-community), the community source port of the original engine.
attr.inst: Copy the data files from your GOG copy of Little Big Adventure 2 Classic to ports/lba2/gamedata/, with LBA2.HQR directly inside.
attr.inst_md: From your [GOG copy of Little Big Adventure 2 Classic](https://www.gog.com/game/little_big_adventure_2), copy the contents of the game's data folder to `ports/lba2/gamedata/`. The `.HQR` files and the video, voice, and music folders should be directly inside `gamedata/` (about 520 MB).
